rows.en: Arthur: "...Can you manage?"
Touya: "I'm fine. It seems more responsive than last time."
Clovis: "Oh...?"
Arthur: "I see. But please don't push yourself too hard."
Touya: "Yeah, I know."
Clovis: "...All right, let's go!"
Barkin: "Hey, what's going on?"
Resh: "Don't ask me."
Subordinate: "Um..."
Barkin: "What?"
Subordinate: "About where that false information was sent..."
Resh: "Don't tell me... You... Which channel did you use?"
Barkin: "Huh? The one you told me... Oh."
Resh: "Y-You idiot! You sent it to Zigrim!
What the hell were you thinking?!"
Barkin: "But their Spirit Mechs are here too."
Resh: "That's just a coincidence.
If we drag Zigrim into this, we'll be in real trouble..."
Subordinate: "Um..."
Barkin: "W-Well, they are one of our sponsors...
But what's done is done.
We can wait for them to wear each other down, then the Spirit Mechs..."
Subordinate: "Um, excuse me..."
Resh: "That's not the point!
If Commander Render finds out, he'll have us shot!"
Subordinate: "Excuse me!"
Barkin: "What is it? You're making a racket."
Subordinate: "I'm sorry. But those Armored Mechs
don't appear to belong to the regular army.
Look, they have no unit markings.
It seems that unit's arrival here
has nothing to do with our information."
Resh: "...True. Even in a war of invasion,
acting in violation of a treaty
would turn international opinion completely against them..."
Barkin: "I don't get all that complicated stuff,
but basically, you're saying it's not my fault?"
Resh: "You understand that part, don't you?"
Barkin: "So, what do we do?"
Subordinate: "It looks like they haven't noticed us yet. Shall we run?"
Barkin: "Tch... Can't be helped. Lucky bastards."
Resh: "You're the one who caused this!"
Barkin: "Grr! You just never shut up!"
Subordinate: "B-Barkin, sir, moving recklessly in a place like this..."
Barkin: "Shut up! A few rocks like these... Oh!"
Resh: "What is it now?"
Barkin: "I've triggered the explosives we planted earlier...
I-It's your fault for leaving them with me..."
Resh: "...You took them by force..."
Barkin: "B-But they haven't exploded.
Are they defective?"
Resh: "...They're chain-detonation explosives.
They take time to go off, but they're powerful."
Barkin: "...Then..."
Resh: "...Exactly."
Barkin: "..."
Subordinate: "...What do we do?"
Resh: "...Run!"
Ai: "Huh. You're pretty good."
Ai: "...Well?"
Ymir: "No luck. There's nothing that could serve as evidence."
Touya: "Those guys were creepy..."
Arthur: "Now, what shall we do?"
Clovis: "Other units could be heading toward Liebhofen,
for all we know.
For now, let's rendezvous with Liebhofen."
Ai: "Right."
Touya: "All right, let's hurry!"

review_batches.context: Read full68-row member and previous first-battle aftermath/next command scene. Touya rejoins fight, Barkin/Resh false-intelligence mishap and withdrawal mishap, then no-evidence aftermath and Liebhofen rendezvous.
review_batches.decisions: Keep inference versus proof about unit markings/treaty and sponsor claim, wrong-channel admission, threats and blame. Triggered explosives not yet exploded; source names delayed powerful chain detonation only, no timings, construction or practical method added. Preserve interrupted subordinates, unfinished plan and no invented evidence, exact ship position or completed rendezvous. Restore settled subjects and correct direction of questions/commands.
